notes: Phase 3a of the full audit (v1.11.55). P-9: «هفته آزمون» — 7 days before a Maz exam the dashboard shows an exam-week bar (countdown, readiness from examReadiness, remaining boxes, checklist: venue, sleep time, error-notebook review); after the exam it becomes «ثبت نتیجه» until a result is recorded. P-10: «از دیروز تا حالا» — one line under the KPIs with yesterday's boxes, real/useful time and the backlog delta (dated-tick based; «هنوز داده کافی نیست» when there is no data). UX-1: one primary action per page (page-primary marker; dashboard/today get a start/stop-current-box button like Space; remaining gets «اعمال بهترین پیشنهاد جبران»; exams gets «باز کردن نزدیک‌ترین آزمون»; testbook promotes «افزودن فصل»; anPrintBtn is analytics' primary; competing page buttons demoted, modal/form buttons unchanged). UX-8: global breadcrumb above the content in every tab (Dashboard + tab + detail, clickable). UX-6: G-prefix keyboard navigation (g then T/D/P/E/A/B; 2 s window; toast on arming; shortcuts guide extended). F5: the exam simulation is persisted in state.sim and resumes after a refresh (expired runs restore without the interval — never auto-finished). F6: the Dey builder seeds pre-existing boxes into its day accounting, warns listing their days, skips their clock intervals and shows them in the preview; also fixes the subject-count filter (entries carry item.subject, so the 2-per-subject cap never fired). PERF-01: one shared getCalStatus() (in-flight dedupe + 5 s TTL; invalidated on sync/push/save/connect) — the 60 s tick now fires at most one /api/calendar/status request. PERF-02: the 1 s tick builds allBoxes() once and returns early with no timer (exam-night reminder gated to once per 60 s). PERF-03: runSaveState() skips the POST when the body is byte-identical to the last sent one. U14: .btn-lime → .btn-primary everywhere (60 occurrences); .stat3.v.lime/.cyan → .v.accent/.v.info. U15: verified — var(--accent) is never used for text; the rule is now recorded in a comment at the accent token definitions. i18n 1296/1296 (26 new keys).
